method: Synthetic Vimy-like ridge for the e2e visual check, sampled at 25 m cell centres: crest at x = 2000 + 150 sin(y/700); west of it 140 - 65(1 - e^(d/1400)), east of it 55 + 85 e^-(d/450)^2 (d = x - crest); +6 e^-(r/350)^2 knoll at (2050, 1000); -10 m re-entrant along y = 250 on the western slope; +1.5 sin(x/310 + y/470) + 1.2 sin(x/530 - y/290) + 0.8 sin((x + y)/170)
